Definition: adverb from participle of G5339; abstemiously, i.e. stingily:--sparingly.
BiblicalUsage: Pheidomenos means sparingly, stingily, and it appears once, in Paul's teaching on giving. He that sows sparingly shall reap also sparingly, and he that sows bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sparing seed is sparing harvest: God measures the reaping by the sowing, and a stingy hand reaps a stingy field.
